definitions.gloss: pest bird; harmful bird; nuisance bird
definitions.explanation: A bird species that causes damage to agriculture, property, or the ecosystem. The designation depends on context — a bird may be considered a pest in farmland but not elsewhere.

examples.japanese: ⟦カラス→カラス：09930_karasu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{害鳥|がいちょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Crows are often considered pest birds.

examples.japanese: {害鳥|がいちょう}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{農作物|のうさくぶつ}→農作物：15271_nousakubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧だ。
examples.english: The damage to crops from pest birds is serious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ぐるみ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{害鳥|がいちょう}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The whole community is working on pest bird countermeasures, but results have been slow to materialize.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{害|がい}→害：02542_gai⟧ (harm, damage) and {鳥|ちょう} (bird). In Japan, common birds designated as {害鳥|がいちょう} include crows (⟦カラス→カラス：09930_karasu⟧), pigeons (ハト), and starlings (ムクドリ) when they damage crops or cause urban nuisance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {害鳥|がいちょう}⟦{駆除|くじょ}→駆除：16374_kujo⟧: pest bird extermination
- {害鳥|がいちょう}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: pest bird countermeasures
- {害鳥|がいちょう}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: damage from pest birds
- {害鳥|がいちょう}⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧: designation as a pest bird

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧: pest insect — the insect equivalent
- ⟦{害獣|がいじゅう}→害獣：24662_gaijuu⟧: pest animal, nuisance animal — mammals that cause damage
- {益鳥|えきちょう}: beneficial bird — the opposite; birds that help agriculture by eating pests
